The earlier transaction results are not retained, so I will retrieve all Venmo sent transactions since January 1, 2023, using the documented endpoint and proper pagination.

```python
sent_transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_access_token, min_created_at=start_date, direction='sent', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    sent_transactions.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print(sent_transactions)
```
